adaptation.owner_authorization: POST /mandates/authorize optionally binds an exact distinct executor DID and caller-supplied liability URI into the Guild-issued authorization credential.
adaptation.payment_join: The optional x402 extension carries the mandate and authorization credentials with JCS digests, the distinct executor DID and original server-verified caller-proof digest, accepts[0] plus the actual Guild-signed offer JWS and digest, the server-derived paid-request digest, and a liability URI explicitly labelled caller_supplied_unverified.
adaptation.enforcement: Before facilitator contact, AG verifies the Guild credentials, cryptographic principal/executor separation, actual signed offer origin/signature/expiry/exact terms, caller proof, request and payment binding. The authorization credential is atomically single-use across payment identity, payload, request, proof and extension; only exact crash recovery by the same executor is accepted.
adaptation.receipt: The final dedicated settlement extension and io.agent-guild/evidence both sign the principal, executor, quote, liability limitations, reservation/settlement/completion lifecycle, transaction, exact request digest and delivered response digest.
adaptation.failure_boundaries: A definitive facilitator verify rejection atomically generation-rolls back the spend-use and payment identifier under the process lock so a corrected signature can retry. Ambiguous verify or settle outcomes remain reserved. Billing and payment recovery records preserve the immutable pre-settlement join, preventing later authority from being attached retroactively to an older transaction.
adaptation.compatibility: When the namespace is absent, ordinary x402 request, response, recovery and record shapes remain unchanged. Version 1 requires acceptIndex 0; future multi-offer selection requires a new advertised contract version.
